ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute', ISPICKVAL(Dispute_Reason__c, "Charged more than once"), OR( ISBLANK(Description), ISBLANK(Amount_Of_Credit_Due__c), ISPICKVAL(Customer_Contacted_Merchant__c, ''), ISBLANK(Merchant_Description__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These fields are required: Description of Issue, Amount of Credit Due, Customer Contacted Merchant, Merchant Description.
